cases.flow-td:
flowchart TD
    A[Start] --> B{Is it?}
    B -->|Yes| C[OK]
    C --> D[Rethink]
    D --> B
    B ---->|No| E[End]
cases.flow-lr-shapes:
flowchart LR
    a[Rect] --> b(Round)
    b --> c([Stadium])
    c --> d[[Subroutine]]
    d --> e[(Database)]
    e --> f((Circle))
    f --> g>Flag]
    g --> h{Rhombus}
    h --> i{{Hexagon}}
    i --> j[/Parallel/]
    j --> k[\Alt\]
    k --> l[/Trapezoid\]
    l --> m[\Inverse/]
    m --> n(((Double)))
cases.flow-edges:
graph LR
    A --- B
    B --> C
    C -.-> D
    D ==> E
    E --o F
    F --x G
    G <--> H
    H -- text --> I
    I -. dotted .-> J
    J == thick ==> K
    K ~~~ L
cases.flow-bt:
graph BT
    A --> B
    A --> C
    B --> D
    C --> D
cases.flow-subgraph:
flowchart TB
    c1-->a2
    subgraph one
    a1-->a2
    end
    subgraph two
    b1-->b2
    end
    subgraph three
    c1-->c2
    end
    one --> two
    three --> two
    two --> c2
cases.flow-style:
flowchart LR
    A:::hot --> B
    B --> C
    classDef hot fill:#f96,stroke:#333,stroke-width:4px
    style C fill:#bbf,stroke:#f66,stroke-width:2px,color:#fff,stroke-dasharray: 5 5
    linkStyle 0 stroke:#ff3,stroke-width:4px
cases.flow-long-label:
flowchart TD
    A["A rather long label that has to wrap across more than one line of text"] --> B["Short"]
    B --> C["Unicode: café, naïve, 日本語"]
    C --> D["**bold** and *italic*"]
cases.sequence:
sequenceDiagram participant Alice participant Bob Alice->>John: Hello John, how are you? loop Healthcheck John->>John: Fight against hypochondria end Note right of John: Rational thoughts
prevail! John-->>Alice: Great! John->>Bob: How about you? Bob-->>John: Jolly good!
cases.sequence-full:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as User
    participant S as Server
    U->>+S: Request
    S-->>-U: Response
    U-)S: Async
    U-xS: Lost
    alt is ok
        S->>U: fine
    else is not
        S->>U: sorry
    end
    opt maybe
        U->>S: again
    end
    par one
        U->>S: a
    and two
        U->>S: b
    end
    Note over U,S: Across both
cases.class:
classDiagram
    Animal <|-- Duck
    Animal <|-- Fish
    Animal : +int age
    Animal : +String gender
    Animal: +isMammal()
    class Duck{
        +String beakColor
        +swim()
        +quack()
    }
    class Fish{
        -int sizeInFeet
        -canEat()
    }
cases.state:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Still
    Still --> [*]
    Still --> Moving
    Moving --> Still
    Moving --> Crash
    Crash --> [*]
cases.gantt:
gantt
    title A Gantt Diagram
    dateFormat YYYY-MM-DD
    section Section
        A task          :a1, 2024-01-01, 30d
        Another task    :after a1, 20d
    section Another
        Task in Another :2024-01-12, 12d
        another task    :24d
cases.pie:
pie title Pets adopted by volunteers
    "Dogs" : 386
    "Cats" : 85
    "Rats" : 15
cases.er:
erDiagram
    CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places
    ORDER ||--|{ LINE-ITEM : contains

mindmap

journey
    title My working day
    section Go to work

      Go upstairs: 3: Me
    section Go home
      Go downstairs: 5: Me

gitGraph

    branch develop

    commit
    checkout main
    merge develop
